[ ONGREDIENTS Cleansing Ball ]
A new paradigm in secondary cleansing, offering a deep yet hydrating cleanse with a natural touch.

✔️ Key Features
 [Powerful Cleansing]
Infused with natural surfactants, this cleansing ball effectively removes skin impurities while keeping the skin fresh and clean.

 [Moisture Balance Protection]
Formulated with a triple moisture energy complex, it helps maintain the skin’s oil-water balance for long-lasting hydration.

 [Gentle & Hydrating Foam]
Creates a rich, elastic microfoam that cleanses without stripping moisture, ensuring a soft and dewy finish.

[Key Ingredients]
Green Tea – Soothes & refreshes
Coconut – Deep cleansing & hydration
Irish Moss – Nourishing & protective

✔️ Volume
- WET : 110g
- DRY : 60g

✔️ How to Use
1. Wet the cleansing ball with water and rub it against a foaming net or hands to create a rich lather.
2. Gently massage the foam onto your face for a deep cleanse.
3. Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

✔️ Brand : ONGREDIENTS
✔️ Condition : New
✔️ Made in Korea
